name: Munster district centres (approximate)
authoritative_note: These are NOT official district boundaries or official centroids. They are hand-picked approximate centre points, chosen so that a Gaussian scatter around them produces visible spatial structure inside the city. They carry no licence obligation because they are not a copy of anybody's data set - they were typed in, not extracted. Do not use them for anything but generating fictitious test data. The authoritative source for Munster's Stadtteil geometry is the city's own open-data portal; it was deliberately not used, because this use case needs a fictional census and not a real boundary (see README, 'Why there is no boundary here').
column_order: latitude before longitude, per CLAUDE.md section 4

bounding_box.comment: The sampling domain and the box the offline verifier checks against. Chosen so the latitude band (51.90..52.00) and the longitude band (7.55..7.72) do not overlap - which is what makes the axis-order check in verify_census.py able to detect a swap at all.

weight_note: weight is the district's relative share of the generated rows, drawn per row rather than filled round-robin. CLAUDE.md section 3: a round-robin fill flattened a measured 6:1 skew into five equal buckets in `opensearch`, and it looked entirely plausible. Weights sum to 100 here, which is a convenience and not a requirement - the generator normalises them.
